rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar (AMs) na Welsh suna damuwa game da "yin kama da muppets"

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu AMs da shawarar canza taken su zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: An samo shi ne saboda shirin canza sunan majalisar zuwa majalisar Welsh.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a ko'ina cikinin al'ummar siyasa suna damuwa cewa zai iya jawo dariya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "jam'iyyar tana damuwa cewa yana da kama da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft kuma pwp yana nufin poo.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memba na Plaid AM ya ce kungiyar aaba "ba ta farin ciki ba" kuma ta ba da shawarar wasu madadin.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani ɗan jam'iyyar Conservative na Wales ya ce kungiyar sa tana da "hankali" game da canza sunan, amma ya lura cewa yana da nisa daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u a Yorkshire English.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana aiki kan dokar da za ta gabatar da gyare-gyaren suna, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani sunan da za a yi wa mambobin Majalisar za ta dogara ne ga mambobin kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba da ikon canza sunan majalisar ta Wales.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani tattaunawa da jama'a kan shawarwarin da suka samu goyon baya sosai wajen kiran taron da Majalisar Welsh.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: Akan batun sunan AMs, hukumar ta fi son mambobin majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya samu mafi yawan goyon baya a wani bincike na jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: AMs suna bayyana wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma ƙalubalen da ke cikin cimma yarjejeniya na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran ta gabatar da kundin shari'a kan gyare-gyaren cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar sauye-sauyen za ta hada da wasu gyare-gyare kan yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka'idoji kan cire 'yan majalisar da kuma tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: AMs za su samu kuri'a ta karshe kan abin da za su kira lokacin da suke tattaunawa kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedoniyawa suna kada kuri'a a zaben da za a canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu kada kuri'a za su yi zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar su zuwa "Jamhuriyar Makkaon Arewa."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne da nufin warware takaddamar da ta dade da makwabciyar kasar Girka, wadda ke da yanki mai suna Masedoniya.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi imanin cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan ƙasar ta, kuma ta ci gaba da adawa da neman shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban Macedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ke adawa da plebiscite kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da kuri'ar.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben suna ikirarin cewa canjin suna kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Kukan Cocin St. Martin's Sun Shuru yayin da Cocin a Harlem ke Gwagwarmaya
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane kusurwa," Mista Adams ya ce.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "Yau, babu."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce, bacewar mashaya tana da ma'ana.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Mutane suna mu'amala da juna ta hanyar daban" yanzu, in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An yi watsi da mashaya a matsayin dakunan zama na unguwanni inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dade kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammanin zai yi ba, "kuma da wuri koaya za su dawo inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Cocin, in ji shi, za a iya maye gurbinsa da gine-gine na gidan zama da gidajen da za su cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa wuraren da suka rage na tsarkaka a yankin ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawancin mutanen da ke sayen gidajen haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance 'yan fari," in ji shi, "kuma hakan zai hanzarta rufewa na waɗannan majami'u gaba daya domin ba zai yiwu ba cewa mafi yawan wadannan mutane da suka koma wannan gidajen haya za su zama mambobin wadannan majami'u."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne ta hanyar al'ummomin fari kafin Harlem ta zama birni mai rinjaye baƙar fata - Al'umma ta Metropolitan a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: An fara da cocin Methodist na fari, sun koma a shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Wani cocin baƙar fata da ke ibada kusa da shi ya karɓi mallakar ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An dauki St. Martin's a karkashin ikon wani cocin baƙar fata karkashin jagorancin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin a kan masu sayar da kaya a titin 125, babban titin sayayya a Harlem, wadanda suka yi adawa da daukar ma'aikata ko kuma inganta baƙar fata.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wani wuta a shekarar 1939 ta bar ginin da munanan lalacewa, amma yayin da Father Johnson's parishioners ke shirya sake gina shi, sun ba da umarni na carillon.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Mallam David Johnson, ɗan Mawallafin Johnson da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da cewa ana kiran carillon "agogo na talakawa."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararren mai kida da ya buga kararrawa a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu daban: "Kasadar al'adu" da "na tarihi da ba za a iya maye gurbinsa ba."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Kwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta kuma lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da aka yi wasa da ita ta wani mai kida baƙar fata, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: A cikin watanni da suka gabata, an yi wani labari mai rikitarwa a St. Martin's game da masu gine-gine da masu aikin gine-gine, wasu da shugabannin cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma da bishop din Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Makarantar limamin - majalisar da ke gudanar da al'umma, wanda ya ƙunshi shugabanni masu zaman kansu - ta rubuta ga bishop a watan Yuli da damuwarta cewa bishop "zai yi ƙoƙari ya wuce farashin" ga majalisar, duk da cewa majalisar ba ta shiga cikin daukar masu zane da masu gina gidan da bishop ya aika ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu ’yan cocin sun yi korafi kan rashin gaskiya daga bangaren cocin.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Chad Hammel ya gaya wa KSWB-TV a San Diego cewa ya yi nutsewa tare da abokai kusan mintuna talatin a safiyar Asabar lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kira don taimako, sai ya yi tafiya tare da wasu don taimakawa su fitar da shi daga cikin ruwa.

rows.output: Hammel ya ce da farko ya yi tunanin cewa kawai sha'awar kama lobster ne, amma sai ya "gane cewa yana yi kuka, 'Na yi rauni!"

rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun yi artabu da masu fafutukar 'yancin kai na Catalan kafin bikin shekaru 1 da za a yi na kin amincewa da 'yancin kai.

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu goyon bayan 'yancin kai suka yi artabu da 'yan sanda, kuma a lokacin da dubban mutane suka shiga zanga-zangar da ta yi adawa da ita domin tunawa da shekara ta farko da Catalonia ta yi zaben raba kai da ya raba kan layi.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani rukuni na masu kare 'yancin kai da aka rufe da 'yan sanda sun yi amfani da kwai da fenti, suna haifar da duhu a titin da yawanci ke cike da masu yawon bude ido.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An yi artabu daga baya a rana da ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da sandunansu wajen gudanar da fadan.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da dama, kungiyoyin da suka goyi bayan 'yancin kai suna ihu da "Ba za a manta ba, ba za a gafarta ba," sun yi ta kai da masu goyon bayan hadin kai suna ihu da "Rayuwa ta Spain."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Maza guda goma sha hudu sun samu magani saboda ƙananan raunukan da suka samu a lokacin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen labarai na yankin.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tunanin ya kasance a cikin yankin da ke son 'yancin kai shekara guda bayanar da kuri'ar ranar 1 ga Oktoba, wanda Madrid ta yi la'akari da shi a matsayin ba bisa ka'ida ba, amma 'yan kasar Catalan sun yi bikin.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: Masu kada kuri'a sun zabi da yawa su zama 'yan kasa da kai, duk da cewa an yi rashin nasara a zaben, saboda masu adawa da rabuwa da suka yi watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: Bisa ga hukumomin Catalan, kusan mutane 1000 ne suka ji rauni a shekarar da ta gabata bayan da ‘yan sanda suka yi yunkurin hana zaben ci gaba a rumfunan zaben a duk yankin, a lokacin da aka yi artabu da juna.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi sansani a daren Jumma'a domin hana wani gangamin goyon bayan 'yan sanda na kasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An yi zanga-zangar amma an tilasta musu su dauki wani sabon hanya.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, wani mai aikin lantarki da ke halartar zanga-zangar rabuwa da matarsa, ya bayyana cewa bai yi fatan samun 'yancin kai na Catalonia ba.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: "A shekara ta baya mun yi rayuwa a cikin daya daga cikin mafi kyawun lokutanmu."
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalli iyayeana suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna iya zabe amma yanzu mun makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun gudanar da nasara mai matukar muhimmanci a zaben yankin a watan Disamba na baya, jam'iyyun Catalan da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi kokarin ci gaba da samun karfin gwiwa a wannan shekara, amma da dama daga cikin manyanugabanninsu da aka fi sani da su suna zaune a waje ba tare da son rai ba, ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a saboda rawar da suka taka wajen gudanar da zaben da kuma shelanta 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, wani mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyaran mota, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zangar goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce an kara rura wutar da ‘yan siyasa a bangarorin biyu suka yi.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana kara zama mai tsanani daani," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin manyan shugabannin Catalan tara da ke kurkukun kafin shari'a tun karshen shekarar da ta gabata, ya sanar da cewa zai tsunduma zaben majalisar dokokin Turai na shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsayawa a matsayin 'yan takara a zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da raguwar darajar dimokuradiyya da kuma zaluncin da gwamnatin Spain ta yi," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: Sabis na Yanayi na Kasa ya riga ya fitar da gargadin ambaliyar ruwa ga Litinin da Talata ga yammacin Arizona zuwa kudu da gabashin Nevada, kudu maso gabashin California da Utah, ciki har da biranen Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, da Salt Lake City.

rows.output: An yi taron bikin a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a lokacin da igiyoyin ruwa masu tsayi kimanin mita shida (ƙafa 18) suka yi karo da bakin teku da faɗuwar rana, inda suka ɗauki mutane da yawa da rayukansu kuma suka lalata duk abin da ke cikin hanyar su.

rows.output: An bi tsunami bayan wani girgizar kasa mai karfi 7.5.

rows.output: "Lokacin da aka samu hadarin tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukan su a bakin teku kuma ba su yi gudu nan take ba, kuma sun zama wadanda suka ji rauni," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kula da bala'i ta kasa BNPB a wani taro a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "An yi ambaliyar ruwa ba kawai ta zo ba, ta ɗauke motoci, itatuwa, gidajen, ta buga komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, inda ya kara cewa ambaliyar ruwa ta yi tafiya a cikin teku mai faɗi da saurin kilomita 800 a kowace awa (497 mph) kafin ta buga gabar teku.

rows.output: "Ƙara kasafin kuɗin bincike na AI sau biyu zai zama kyakkyawan farawa, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa duk sauran ƙasashe suna da nisa a bayan Amurka, kuma muna neman sabuwar nasara a AI," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Karfafa kudi na iya kara yawan yiwuwar cewa babban nasarar AI ta gaba za ta samu a Amurka, in ji Lee da CNBC a wata hira da aka yi a wannan makonni.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: Lee, wanda littafin sa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" an buga shi wannan watan da Houghton MifflinHarcourt, shi ne Shugaban Kamfanin Sinovation Ventures, wanda ya saka hannun jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanoni na AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin shekarun 1980 a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI da ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, daga baya kuma ya kasance jami'in gudanar da bincike na Microsoft kuma shugaban reshen Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasa ta fasaha ta gwamnati ta Amurka a baya kamar gasar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge kuma ta tambayi lokacin da na gaba zai kasance, domin taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masana a Amurka galibi suna aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin ne ke daukar masu ilimi; kamfanoni ne."
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanoni na fasaha sun dauki manyan masana daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin 'yan shekaru masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ya ce canje-canjen manufofin shige da fice na iya taimakawa Amurka wajen karfafa kokarinta na AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina ganin katin kore ya kamata a ba da shi ta atomatik ga PhD's a AI," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Hukumar Jiha ta kasar Sin ta fitar da shirin Ci gaban Hankali na Gaba a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Ƙasar Sin tana samar da kudin bincike ga mutane a cikin cibiyoyin ilimi kamar yadda Ma'aikatar Kimiyya ta Kasa da sauran kungiyoyin gwamnati ke yi a Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi a China ya yi ƙasa, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekara, Ma'aikatar Tsaron Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar AI ta Hadin Gwiwa, wadda ke nufin ta haɗa kai da masu shirya shirye daga masana'antu da jami'o'i, kuma Fadar White ta sanar da kafa kwamitin da za a zaɓa kan AI.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar Ma’aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa wata Cibiyar Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Ba, wanda aka shirya don ta sa abokan hulɗa daga masana’anta da makaranta, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da ƙirƙirar wani Zaɓaɓɓen Kwamiti a kan Hikimar da ba ta asali ba.

rows.output: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin biliyan $2 a cikin wani shiri da ake kira AI Next.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a cikin wani ƙoƙari da ake kira AI Next.

rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana saka fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.
rows.reference: A game da NSF, a yanzu haka ta zuba jarin fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.

rows.output: A lokacin da, an dakatar da dokar Amurka da ke neman kafa kwamitin tsaro na kasa kan hankali na wucin gadi.
rows.reference: A halin da ake ciki yanzu, dokar Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar wata Hukumar Tsaron Ƙasa kan Hikimar Da Ba Asali tana nan ba ta ga wani aiki ba a cikin watanni.

rows.output: Macedonians suna zabe a zaben da za su canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.output: An yi zabe a ranar Lahadi a kasar Makidoniya kan ko za a canza sunan kasar zuwa "Jamhuriyar Arewa ta Makidoniya," wanda zai warware rikicin da ya dade da kasar Girka, wanda ya hana neman shiga kungiyar Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da yanki mai suna Macedonia, tana ikirarin cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar da'awar ƙasa, kuma ta hana shiga NATO da EU.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Gwamnatin biyu ta yi yarjejeniyar a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka gabatar, amma masu adawa da ra'ayin kasa sun ce canza sunan zai rage asalin kasa na mutanen Slavic mafi yawan jama'ar Masedoniya.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaban Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zabe a zaben ba kuma yakin neman zabe ya haifar da shakku ko za a iya cimma kashi 50 cikin 100 na masu kuri'a da ake bukata don zaben ya yi inganci.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Tambayar a cikin kuri'ar raba gardama ta karanta: "Kuna goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka."
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan sauya sunan, ciki har da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun ce hakan farashi ne da ya dace da neman shiga cikin kungiyoyi kamar EU da NATO ga Makka, daya daga cikin kasashe da suka fito daga rushewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: "Na zo yau ne domin ina son ina zabe ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Masedoniya domin su iya rayuwa cikin 'yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai domin yana nufin rayuwa mai kyau ga kowa," in ji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a iya tilasta shi ta hanyar doka ba, isassun mambobin majalisar dokoki sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon zaben, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama mai tasiri sosai.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sunan canza zai bukaci rinjaye biyu bisa uku a majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar gudanar da zaben jihar ta bayyana cewa ba a samu rahoton rashin daidaito ba da misalin karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, an yi rajistar masu jefa kuri'a kusan kashi 16 cikin 100, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34 cikin 100 a zaben majalisar dokoki na 2016 lokacin da kashi 66 cikin 100 na masu rajistar sun yi kuri'a.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: "Na fito na zabe saboda 'ya'yana, wurinmu yana Turai," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya yi zabe a babban birnin, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị AM Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere nchegbu n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs n'ihe gbasara atụmatụ mgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ malitere n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha nke ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe usoro ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpata ịkpọasị.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu onye Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-ada ụda na Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara onye na-adịghị mma n'uche ma pwp pụtara ihe na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu AM na-
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na otu ya "na-emeghe uche" banyere mgbanwe aha, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere okwu okwu site na MWP ruo Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'okwu a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka okwu Yorkshire Bekee nke mkpụrụedemede u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ nke na-ede iwu ugbu a iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "mkpebi ikpeazụ maka ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Assembly bụ, n'ezie, ihe ga-adabere n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Wales Act 2017 nyere ndị Welsh assembly ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, Kọmishọn bipụtara nsonaazụ nyocha ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọna ahụ chọrọ ndị otu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kacha ukwuu n'oge nyocha ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AMs na-ekwu na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana ọsọ ọsọ iri n'otu n'ime ndị a nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi ike nye onye isi oche, Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebipụta atụmatụ iwu maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe ahụ ga-agụnyekwa mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otú ụlọ omebe iwu si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu gbasara ịhapụ ndị otu na nhazi usoro kọmiti.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enweta votu ikpeazụ na ajụjụ nke ihe ha kwesịrị ịkpọ mgbe ha na-eme iwu.
rows.reference: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-aga n'ihu n'ọchịchị n'ọchịchị na-agbanwe aha obodo ahụ
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha

rows.output: Ndị na-eme ntuli aka ga-eme ntuli aka na Sọnde ma ọ bụrụ na ha gabanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.reference: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atuli aka na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ “Repọbliki nke North Macedonia.”

rows.output: Vootu ndị mmadụ na-achọ ịhọpụta onye isi ala bụ ihe e mere iji dozie esemokwu ogologo oge na obodo dị n'akụkụ, nke a na-akpọ Macedonia.
rows.reference: Atọlitere ntuli aka nke igwe mmadụ iji kpezie esemokwu ogologo oge dị n’etiti ndị agbataobi bụ Greece, nke nwere mpaghara nke ya akpọrọ Macedonia.

rows.output: Ọdịnihu Athens na-ekwu na aha onye agbata obi ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-ekwu na ọ na-achọ ala ya ma na-emegide mbọ ya ịbanye na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, onye na-emegide ntuli aka ahụ gbasara mgbanwe aha, kwuru na ya ga-ewepụta ntuli aka ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov nke Macedonia, onye iro nke ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ, ekwuola na ọ ga-eleghara ntuli aka ahụ anya.

rows.output: Ọbụna ndị na-akwado ntuli aka ahụ, gụnyere onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-arụ ụka na mgbanwe aha bụ naanị ọnụ ahịa a ga-akwụ iji banye na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ndị nkwado nke nhọpụta ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrụ aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.

rows.output: Mkpọchi nke St. Martin's na-ada ụda ka ụlọ ụka dị na Harlem na-alụ ọgụ
rows.reference: Mgbịrịmgba nke St. Martin Dara Jụụ ka Ndị Ụlọ Ụka dị na Harlem Na Agba Mba

rows.output: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, ndị okenye m gwara na e nwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n'akụkụ ọ bụla.
rows.reference: “N’akụkọ ochie, ndị okenye m gwara okwu kwuru na enwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n’akụkụ niile,” Maazị Adams kwuru.

rows.output: "Taa, enweghị ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: “Taa, enweghị nke ọ bụla.”

rows.output: Ọ kwuru na ịla n'iyi nke ụlọ mmanya bụ ihe a na-ahụ anya.
rows.reference: O kwuru na aghọtara ọpụpụ nke ụlọ mmanya ndị ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị mmadụ na-akparịta ụka n'ụzọ dị iche ugbu a, o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ na emerịkọta n’ụzọ dị iche iche” ugbu a, o kwuru.

rows.output: "Ọkụ na-abụghị ebe obibi obodo ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga mgbe niile."
rows.reference: “Ụlọ mmanya abụghịzị ime ụlọ nke gburugburu ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga kwa oge.”

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara ụlọ ụka, ọ na-echegbu onwe ya na ego sitere na ire ihe onwunwe agaghị adịru ogologo oge ka ndị isi na-eche, "ma n'oge na-adịghị anya ha ga-alaghachi ebe ha malitere."
rows.reference: Maka ndị ụlọ ụka, ọ na echekasị na ego enwetere na ịre akụ agaghị anọte aka otu ndị isi si chee, “ma n’oge adịghị anya ma ọ bụ emechaa ha ga-alaghachite ebe ha bidoro.”

Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, onye na-ekwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka igbochi ihe mberede na mgbasa ozi (BNPB) kwuru n'oge a na-eme n'obodo Jakarta.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ihe egwu tsunami ahụ bidoro ụnyahụ, ndị mmadụ nọ na eme mmemme ha n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, ha agbaghị ọsọ ozugbo, ya mere o ji metụta ha,” Sutopo Purwo Nugrogo, okwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ njikwa ọdachi mba nke Indonesia BNPS kwuru na nchịkọta na Jakarta.

rows.output: "Ọ bụghị naanị mgbawa mmiri ahụ mere, ọ na-ebu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ na-akụ ihe ọ bụla n'ala," Nugroho kwuru, na-ekwu na mgbawa mmiri ahụ gbara ọsọ 800 kph (497 mph) n'oké osimiri tupu ọ daa n'akụkụ osimiri.
rows.reference: “Tsunami ahụ abịaghị n’aka ya, o burulu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe niile nọ n’ala,” Nugroho kwuru, na ekwukwa na tsunami ahụ gafere na nnukwu osimiri n’ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu o daruo n’akụkụ osimiri.

rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ rịgoro n’osisi ka ha si n’ebili mmiri pụọ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ rịrị elu osisi iji gbanarị tsunami ahụ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.

rows.output: N'ime ihe dị ka mmadụ 16,700, a chụpụrụ ha gaa n'ụlọ ọrụ 24 dị na Palu.
rows.reference: Ebugara ihe ruru ndị mmadụ 16,700 n’ama 24 dị na Palu.

rows.output: Foto ikuku e wepụtara site n'ụlọ ọrụ ihe mberede gosiri ọtụtụ ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa mebiri emebi, àkwà mmiri gbawara agbawa na daa, na ụlọ ala mmiri gbara gburugburu.
rows.reference: Ọsịse elu nke ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi ahụ buputere gosiri imirikiti ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa emebisiri, akwa mmiri gbagochara ma daa yana ụlọ alakụba mmiri gbara okirikiri.

rows.output: Mmetụta ndị ọzọ gbara obodo dị n'akụkụ osimiri n'ụbọchị Satọde.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji gara n’ihu na eme n’ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ na Satọde.

rows.output: Mmetụta nke mmiri na-efe efe ahụ dị na mpaghara nwere mmadụ nde 2.4.
rows.reference: Enwere mmetụta usoro nke ala ọmajiji na mpaghara nwere ndị mmadụ nde 2.4.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka nyocha na itinye teknụzụ (BPPT) kwuru n'okwu na ike e wepụtara site na nnukwu ala ọma jijiji nke Fraịde bụ ihe dị ka 200 ugboro ike bọmbụ atomik nke e tụrụ na Hiroshima n'oge Agha Ụwa Abụọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Ọrụ maka Nyocha na Ntinye nke Teknụzụ nke Indonesia (BPPT) kwuru na nkwupute na ike nnukwu ọmajiji nke Fraịde buputere dị ihe dị ka ugboro 200 nke ike nke ogbunigwe atọmik atụsara na Hiroshima na Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.

rows.output: Ọdịdị obodo ahụ, nke dị n'akụkụ ọnụ nke ogologo, obere ọdọ mmiri, nwere ike ime ka oke oke mmiri ahụ dịkwuo ukwuu, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ala nke obodo ahụ, nke tukwu na ngwụcha nke mpaghara osimiri toro ogologo, dị warawara, nwere ike ibuwanye nha nke tsunami ahụ, ka o kwuru.

rows.output: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ dị ka "nke ukwuu" ma kwuo na puku puku ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ụlọ ahịa, na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dara.
rows.reference: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ ka “ihe gbasara agbasa” ma kwuo puku kwụrụ puku nke ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ọdụ ụlọ ahịa na ụlọ nkwari dara.

rows.output: Mkpụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị ahụ nwụrụ anwụ ka achọtara n'okpuru ihe ndị dara ada nke ụlọ ndị dara ada, o kwuru, na-ekwu na mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ na mmadụ 29 naefunụ.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ ọ metụtara n’okpuru ahịhịa nke ụlọ ndị dara, o kwuru, tinye ndị mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ ma 29 na efu.

rows.output: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ anwụ na mmebi ihe nwere ike ịdị ukwuu n'akụkụ osimiri 300 km (190 kilomita) n'ebe ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na-akpọ Donggala, nke dị nso na ebe mgbawa nke ala ọma jikwa.
rows.reference: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ yana mmebi nwere ike ịkarị n’ogologo ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ 300km (maịlụ 190) n’akụkụ ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na akpọ Donggala, nke nọketere nso na etiti nke ọmajiji ahụ.

rows.output: Nkwurịta okwu "bụ nke e wepụrụ kpamkpam na-enweghị ozi ọ bụla" site na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.
rows.reference: Nkwukọrịta enweghị ozi ọ bụla ma ncha sitere na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.

rows.output: Enwere ihe karịrị 300,000 mmadụ bi n'ebe ahụ," ndị Red Cross kwuru n'okwu, na-ekwu na ndị ọrụ ha na ndị otu ha na-aga ebe ihe metụtara.
rows.reference: Enwere karịa ndị mmadụ 300,000 bi ebe ahụ,” Red Cross kwuru na nkwupute, na etinye na ndị ọrụ ya na ndị wepụtara onwe ha na aga n’ebe ndị emetụtara.

rows.output: Nke a bụ ihe na-akụda mmụọ, ma ọ nwere ike ime ka ọ njọ.
rows.reference: O kwuru “nke a abụrụla ihe mberede, mana ọ nwere ike ịkawanye njọ,”.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọde, ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nwetara nnukwu nkatọ maka na ha emeghị ka ha mara na tsunami kụrụ Palu, n'agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na ebili mmiri ahụ rutere n'oge a na-enye ịdọ aka ná ntị.
rows.reference: Ekwutọrọ ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nke ukwuu na Satọde maka ịhapụ ikwu na tsunami dara na Palu, agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na nnukwu ikuku bịara n’oge enyere ịdọ aka na ntị ahụ.

rows.output: N'ime vidiyo ndị na-abụghị nke ọma ekesara na mgbasa ozi ọha, otu nwoke n'elu ụlọ nwere ike ịnụ ka ọ na-akwa ákwá n'ụzọ na-adịghị mma na ndị mmadụ n'okporo ụzọ dị n'okpuru.
rows.reference: Na nseta ekekọrịtara n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze enwere ike ịnụ ka otu nwoke nọ n’elu ụlọ na eti nnukwu mkpu na adọ aka na ntị maka tsunami na abịa nke ọ na agwa ndị mmadụ n’okporo ụzọ dị n’okpuru.

rows.output: N'ime nkeji ole na ole, mgbidi mmiri na-ada n'akụkụ osimiri, na-ebu ihe owuwu na ụgbọ ala.
rows.reference: N’ime nkeji ole ma ole nnukwu mmiri dara n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, buru ụlọ na ụgbọ ala.

rows.output: Reuters enwetaghị ohere ime ka ihe onyonyo ahụ bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịdabere na ya ozugbo.
rows.reference: Reuters enwenwughi ike inyocha nseta ahụ.

rows.output: Mgbawa ahụ na ebili mmiri mere ka ọpụpụ ike dị mkpa nke mere ka nkwurịta okwu gharazie n'akụkụ Palu, na-eme ka ọ sie ike maka ndị ọchịchị iji hazie mbọ nnapụta.
rows.reference: Ọmajiji na tsunami ahụ butere nnukwu mmebi n’ọkụ latrik nke gbubiri nkwukọrịta n’okirikiri Palu na eme ka ndị ikikere nwee nhịahụ na ịhazi mbọ ịzọpụta ndị mmadụ.

rows.output: Ndị agha amalitelarị iziga ụgbọ elu ibu na enyemaka sitere n'obodo Jakarta na ndị ọzọ, ndị ọchịchị kwuru, mana ndị a na-akpọpụta ka chọrọ nri na ihe ndị ọzọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ndị agha ebidola iziga ụgbọ elu eji ebu ibu bu ihe enyemaka sitere na Jakarta yana obodo ndị ọzọ, ndị ikikere kwuru, mana ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ka chọrọ nri na akụrụngwa ndị ọzọ eji ebi ndụ ngwangwa.

rows.output: Obodo ahụ emegheworị naanị maka mbọ enyemaka na ga-anọgide na-emechi ruo Ọktoba.
rows.reference: Emepegharịala ọdụ ụgbọ elu nke obodo ahụ naanị maka mbọ ihe enyemaka, a ga-aga n’ihu mechie ya ruo Ọkt.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo bu n'eme atụmatụ ịga ụlọ mgbaba nọ na Palu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Joko Widodo kwesịrị ịbịa n’ama mgbabata ọsọ ndụ ndị dị na Palu na Sọnde.

rows.output: Mmụba nke 800 karịa.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ Tsunami Indonesia Agafeela 800.

rows.output: Ọ dị njọ nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ọ Jọrọ Oke Njọ.

rows.output: N'ime ndị ọrụ World Vision si Donggala, ndị e mere n'udo ruo Palu, ebe ndị ọrụ na-anọ n'ụlọ nche tarpaulin e mere n'ogige ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha hụrụ ihe mgbapụta n'ụzọ ahụ, Maazị Doseba kwuru.
rows.reference: Ebe ndị ọrụ World Vision si Donggala garuru n’obodo Palu na enweghị nsogbu, ebe ndị ọrụ ya na anara ndo n’okpuru mkpuchi tapọlin atọlitere na mpụga nke ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha gafere okirikiri nke mbibi n’ụzọ ha, Maazị Doseba kwuru.

rows.output: "O kwuru na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ ndị e bibiri."
rows.reference: O kwuru “ha gwara m na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ emebiri,”.

rows.output: Ọ dị oke njọ.
rows.reference: Ọ jọrọ oke njọ.

rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe ndị otu enyemaka malitere mmegharị ihe na-adịghị mma nke inye enyemaka, ụfọdụ ndị na-akọ na ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ofesi nwere nnukwu ihe ọmụma na-egbochi ha ịga Palu.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi ka ndị otu enyemaka bidoro ọrụ nhịahụ nke ibido ụkwụ nke ihe enyemaka ọdachi, ụfọdụ kpesara na a na egbochi ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ofesi nwere nka dị mkpa na ịga na Palu.

rows.output: N'ime iwu Indonesia, itinye ego, inye ihe, na ndị ọrụ si mba ọzọ nwere ike ịmalite naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ebe ihe mberede dị na mpaghara ihe mberede nke mba.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndị iwu nke Indonesia, ego, ngwa na ndị ọrụ si na mba ofesi nwere naanị ike ibido ịga ma ọ bụrụ na akpọọ ebe nke mbibi ahụ ihe ogige ọdachi mba.

rows.output: Nke ahụ emebeghị.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ emebeghị.

rows.output: "Ọ ka bụ ihe mberede dị na ọkwa steeti," ka Aulia Arriani, onye na-ekwuchitere Indonesian Red Cross kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ ka bụ ọdachi ọkwa ogige,” Aulia Arriani kwuru, onye okwu okwu maka Red Cross nke Indonesia.

rows.output: "Ozugbo gọọmentị kwuru, "O.K., nke a bụ ihe mberede mba," anyị nwere ike imeghe maka enyemaka mba ụwa mana enweghị ọnọdụ."
rows.reference: “Ozugbo gọọmentị ahụ kwuru, “Ọ dị mma, nke a bụ ọdachi mba,” anyị nwere ike imepe maka enyemaka ofesi mana enwebeghị ọkwa ọ bụla.”

rows.output: N'abalị nke abụọ nke Palu mgbe mgbawa ala na tsunami mere na Fraịde, ndị enyi na ndị ikwu nke ndị ka na-efunụ anya na-eche na ndị ha hụrụ n'anya ga-abụ ihe omume ebube nke ga-eme ka akụkọ ndị na-adịghị mma nke ihe ndị na-eme n’okike dị mfe.
rows.reference: Ka abalị nke abụọ dara na Palu ka ala ọmajiji na tsunami nke Fraịde mechara, ndị enyi na ezinụlọ nke ndị ka na efu jidere okwukwe na ndị ha hụrụ n’anya ga-abụ ọrụ ebube na akpalite mmụọ nke akụkụ ọjọọ nke ọdachi ekereụwa.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọde, e wepụrụ nwa nwoke nọ n'ime mmiri.
rows.reference: Na Satọde, akpapụtara otu obere nwa n’ime olulu.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Sọnde, ndị na-azụ ọgụ napụtara nwanyị nke e ji ihe arụ na-akụ ya ihe ruo ụbọchị abụọ, nwere ahụ nne ya n'akụkụ ya.
rows.reference: Na Sọnde, ndị mgbata ọsọ enyemaka zọpụtara otu nwanyị nke akpadoro n’okpuru ahịhịa n’ime ụbọchị abụọ, n’akụkụ ya bụ ahụ nne ya.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, onye nkuzi otu ndị Indonesia na-agba ọsọ, zụrụ ndị na-agba ọsọ abụọ naefunahụ maka egwuregwu Asia, nke mechara n'ọnwa a na Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, onye ndu nke ndị otu paraglaịdịn nke mba Indonesia, zụrụ mmadụ abụọ nke ndị paraglaịdas maka Egwuregwu Asia na efu, nke mechiri na mbido nke ọnwa a na Indonesia.

rows.output: Ndị ọzọ nke ndị e jidere n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ Roa Roa, Maazị Mandagi gụnyere, bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ya.
rows.reference: Ndị ọzọ nke ejidere n’okpuru Ụlọ Nkwari Akụ Roa Roa, Maazị Mandagi gụnyere, bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

rows.output: "Dị ka onye isi na ubi paragliding, enweela m ibu mmetụta uche nke m."

rows.output: Ọkụ Gendon kwuru otú, n'ime awa ndị na-esote akụkọ nke Roa Roa Hotel dara, o zigara ozi WhatsApp na-adịghị mma nye ndị asọmpi Palu, bụ́ ndị na-eme mmemme nọ n'akụkụ osimiri.
rows.reference: Maazị Gendon chetara otu, n’ime elekere ka akụkọ nke ọdịda Ụlọ Nkwari Akụ Roa Roa gbasara n’ime ogbe paraglaịdịn, o ji ọsọ zigara ndị asọmpi Palu ozi na WhatsApp, ndị na esonye n’emume akụkụ osimiri ahụ.

rows.output: Ozi ya, n'agbanyeghị, mere naanị otu akaracha ọcha, kama ihe abụọ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ.
rows.reference: Ozi ya, agbanyeghị, dapụtara naanị n’otu nrịbama agba ntụ, kama nrịbama agba eluigwe dị mkpị.

rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na nke ahụ pụtara na ozi ahụ ebughị."

rows.reference: Ndị oyi n’ụtụtụ Fraịde zuru $26,750 n’aka onye ọrụ Brink na ekpojugharị ATM dị na Newport na Levee, site na akụkọ ebuputere n’aka Ngalaba Ndị Uwe Ojii Newport.

rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ na-ewepụ ego n'igwe ATM n'ime ebe ntụrụndụ ma na-akwadebe ibugharị ego ọzọ, ka Det. Dennis McCarthy kwuru n'ụzọ pụrụ iche.
rows.reference: Ọkwọ ụgbọ ala nke ụgbọ ala ahụ na ekpochapụ ATM dị n’ụlọ ntụrụndụ ahụ ma na akwadobe itinyekwu ego ọzọ, Onye Uwe Ojii. Dennis McCarthy dere na nkwupute ahụ.

rows.output: N'oge ahụ, otu nwoke ọzọ "si n'azụ onye ọrụ Brink's" gburu ihe ma zuo akpa ego e mere ijieta.
rows.reference: Ka ọ nọ n’ọrụ, nwoke ọzọ “si n’azụ wụchibido onye ọrụ nke Brink ahụ” wee zuru akpa ego ezubere maka nnyefe.

rows.output: Ndị akaebe hụrụ ọtụtụ ndị a na-enyo enyo na-agba ọsọ n'ebe ihe ahụ mere, dịka nkwupụta ahụ si kwuo, mana ndị uwe ojii akọwaghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị metụtara ihe ahụ.

rows.reference: “Apụtara m ituli aka n’ihi ụmụaka m, ọnọdụ anyị bụ na Europe,” ka Gjose Tanevski kwuru, 62, onye ntuli aka n’isi ala, Skopje.
